[package]
name = "kvhttp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "In-memory HTTP/1.1 key-value server"
publish = false

[dependencies]
axum = { version = "0.8", default-features = false, features = ["http1", "tokio"] }
bytes = "1"
serde_json = "1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "net", "macros"] }

[profile.release]
lto = true
codegen-units = 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary and places it at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

cargo build --release --locked
cp target/release/kvhttp app
chmod +x app
